messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — metering.alerts.token_drift (sev:high). Reason: sudden token-count skew vs shadow aggregator (>12% delta). Auto-escalation to oncall.

oncall-ryan: I'm on it. Quick context: alert started ~ 1719102100, delta spiked after a deploy to emitter service.

maria: @oncall-ryan seeing same in dashboards — main ingest shows 1.2M tokens/min, shadow aggregator shows 1.05M. Overflagging customers starting ~ 15m ago.

jonathan: Any known deploys? I rolled a small hotfix to emitter at 1719101800 but it passed smoke. Reverting?

oncall-ryan: Hold on revert until we confirm root. Reverting could mask observability. First mitigation: temp pause overage-notify job for affected windows. That prevents customer emails.

incident-bot: Action logged: paused job billing/overage-notify (by oncall-ryan) — reason: avoid noisy customer alerts while investigating.

billing-lee: Good call. Can we also pause auto-apply-quota? We should avoid automated throttles based on noisy counts.

oncall-ryan: Paused apply-quota too. (docs: runbook step A3)

sre-amy: Running quick comparison script against KV cache and shadow aggregator. Snippet: ```python
# compare totals
main = get_counter('tokens_main')
shadow = get_counter('tokens_shadow')
print(main, shadow, (main-shadow)/shadow)
```

maria: Output from grafana panel (copied): "main: 1_198_345; shadow: 1_052_010; delta: 14.0%"

jonathan: That's consistent with emitter add header change I shipped (I updated batching to prefer legacy checksum field). Could that double-count some prefix fragments?

jonathan: Pasting patch: ```diff
- payload.checksum = x
+ payload.meta.checksum = x
```

oncall-ryan: Possible. Let's run a canary revert on one emitter shard instead of full revert. Rolling back shard-3 now.

incident-bot: Deploy bot: rollback start (emitter/shard-3) — triggered by oncall-ryan.

support-kate: Customer impact summary for comms: ~120 orgs showed transient overage flag; billing UI shows flagged but invoices not issued yet. We should send an internal holding note to CS.

billing-lee: Confirm invoices not auto-generated until midnight; safe window to investigate. We'll keep overage notifications blocked and prepare a targeted email if needed.

sre-amy: After rollback on shard-3 delta dropped to ~4.2% on that shard. Other shards still at ~13%. Rolling revert across remaining shards incrementally.

oncall-ryan: Running a coordinated rollback across emitter regions eu/us/apac with 30s pause between. Monitoring token delta and queue depth.

maria: Observability: KV cache hit-rate unchanged, so this looks like counting duplication at emitter layer rather than ingest loss.

jonathan: Confirmed: my batching change read meta twice for certain tiny payloads. Fix prepared and will ship as proper patch after rollback.

incident-bot: Rollback complete (emitter all shards). Delta stabilized to 1.8% company-wide.

billing-lee: Re-enable overage-notify in 10m? Suggest we wait until delta <1% for two consecutive 1m windows.

oncall-ryan: Agreed. We'll hold for 20m, run a reconciliation job comparing shadow vs main for full hour window, and then re-enable notifications.

support-kate: Drafted CS internal note (short): "We observed transient overage flags for a subset of customers due to a metering counting issue; we've paused alerting and are reconciling counts. No invoices were issued. We'll follow up with remediation and make-whole plan if needed." Need signoff.

billing-lee: Sign off. Also capture affected org IDs for follow-up.

jonathan: I'll open a PR with the fix and include unit tests for tiny-payload path.

maria: Postmortem owners? Suggest jonathan (code), amy (runtime), billing-lee (customer impact). I'll schedule writeup.

oncall-ryan: Assigning postmortem: owners as suggested. Action items: 1) revert + proper fix (jonathan) 2) add integration test for tiny payloads (jonathan) 3) improve alerting to compare shadow/main ratio with rolling baseline (sre-amy) 4) run reconcile job and issue make-whole if customers billed (billing-lee).

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Severity downgraded to low. Recording timeline and actions in incident tracker: https://internal.redwood/incidents/1719102222

support-kate: I'll notify CS and standby for any escalations.

jonathan: PR created: "fix: avoid double-read on tiny payloads" https://git.internal/redwood/emitter/pull/482

maria: Reconcile job run started. Comparing last 60m windows between main and shadow; will post summary in 10m.

sre-amy: Recommendation: add a canary test that validates token counters on each deploy for a minute-long synthetic workload. Filed ticket #INF-987.

billing-lee: Thanks team. We'll follow up with affected customers if reconcile shows invoice exposure. Otherwise retro and learnings in postmortem. :thumbsup:

oncall-ryan: Closing thread — if anything spikes, re-open pager. Great work. :clap:
